messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Smart-routing fallback loop detected for route 'text-gen-prod' — elevated 5xx and retries across regions. Impact: ~12% increased p99 latency, 3 customer error reports. Paging on-call SRE.
Maya (SRE): taking it. seeing repeated 'tool_call_not_supported' errors in the logs from model variants after routing. putting a hot channel. @Jonah @Priya please join.
Jonah (Runtime): on it. grabbing traces. anything in releases in last hour?
Priya (ML Infra): I rolled out compatibility-matrix update 10m ago that marks quant-variant-q4 as tool_call:true for several models — can revert if needed.
Emily (Support): multiple customers reported errors when using tool-calling endpoints, some saw degraded results. Customer A (oliver) escalated and needs ETA.
Oliver (Customer Success): Customer A says production jobs started failing around 12:07 UTC.
Jonah (Runtime): reading trace: router sends to quant-variant-q4 in eu-west, model responds with 400 + 'tool-call not implemented' -> router falls back to region us-east -> different variant can't accept request shape -> request retries back to eu-west -> loop. stack shows routing policy uses compatibility matrix to decide variants.
Maya (SRE): ok root cause likely the matrix marking q4 as tool-call compatible incorrectly. that explains loop between regions and variants.
Alex (Product): if q4 can't support tool calling, routing policy should not advertise it. what's the mitigation path? rollback matrix or patch router to prefer fp16?
Priya (ML Infra): fastest: rollback the matrix entry. I can remove the tool_call flag for q4 and push a patch now. will also add a guard to the matrix validator.
Jonah (Runtime): secondary: temporary policy to pin route to fp16 variant. apply via CLI to avoid full rollout.
Maya (SRE): do both. rollback matrix + apply routing pin, then scale up fp16 pool to absorb traffic.
Priya (ML Infra): executing rollback now.
Priya (ML Infra): ```
git checkout -b hotfix/compat-matrix-rollback
git revert --no-edit 3f6b2a9
git push origin hotfix/compat-matrix-rollback
./deploy-matrix --env prod --confirm
``` 
Priya (ML Infra): matrix change reverted and deployed. validator added locally, will open PR for mainline.
Jonah (Runtime): applying pin policy:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route text-gen-prod --variant prefer:fp16 --reason "hotfix: avoid quant tool-call loop"
```
Jonah (Runtime): pin applied. verifying.
Maya (SRE): scaling fp16 pool + warming caches.
Maya (SRE): `kubectl scale deployment fp16-prod --replicas=20 -n inference-prod`
Maya (SRE): warming cache prefixes, hitting endpoints with synthetic warmup.
Emily (Support): updating Customer A: "We identified a routing config issue affecting tool-calling for quantized variants; we have reverted the compatibility metadata and pinned traffic to the fp16 variants. We're monitoring — ETA 15m." :thumbsup:
Oliver (Customer Success): Customer A responded: "thanks, running smoke tests now — will confirm in ~10m".
Jonah (Runtime): metrics: 5xx count dropping, p99 latency trending down. traces show no more ping-pongs between regions.
Priya (ML Infra): will open post-incident PR with a validator entry: matrix entries must include runtime_capabilities list, and tool_call requires handshake test.
Alex (Product): also add a canary check to routing that rejects variants with mismatched capability flags during rollout.
Maya (SRE): forwarding to postmortem channel after containment. quick notes: timeline, root cause = incorrect compatibility-matrix entry marking quant variant as tool-call capable; mitigation = rollback + routing pin + scale/warm; impact = some customers had failures, degraded p99 for route.
IncidentBot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident assigned: INC-2026-348. Postmortem owner: Priya (ML Infra).
Priya (ML Infra): filing the postmortem now and tagging follow-ups: validator PR, canary check, alert rule on matrix churn. will include reproduction steps.
Maya (SRE): thanks everyone. stand down when customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
Oliver (Customer Success): Customer A confirms smoke tests pass. closing loop.
Jonah (Runtime): will follow up with a small automation to detect incompatible handshake responses that cause retries.
Emily (Support): closing support ticket, will send summary to customers impacted.
